attr.title: Everlasting Summer
attr.desc: A visual novel about a week in a Soviet pioneer camp. Plays the Steam release with Workshop mod support.
attr.inst: Get the game for free on Steam. Copy everything inside its game folder except mods, cache and saves into ports/everlastingsummer/game. The first start prepares it for your screen, once (about 8 minutes). Steam Workshop mod folders go in ports/everlastingsummer/workshop.
attr.inst_md: Get the game for free on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/331470/). Copy everything inside its `game` folder except `mods`, `cache` and `saves` into `ports/everlastingsummer/game/`. The first start prepares it for your screen, once (about 8 minutes). Steam Workshop mod folders go in `ports/everlastingsummer/workshop/`.
